questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:06 onwards, three pens are clearly visible on the white board.
All three pens are oriented with the black cap/end at the bottom and the translucent barrel at the top.
All three pens have identical black caps and translucent grey barrels.
All pens appear to have their caps on (black part present) and are of equal length.
The board moves from left to right until roughly 00:06, then stops completely and remains frozen in place until the end of the video at 00:17.
The pens remain fixed in their slots on the board throughout the clip.

parsed.reason: The board stops moving and freezes mid-travel around the 6-second mark, remaining stationary for the rest of the video, which violates the requirement for smooth, continuous motion.
